trust_boundaries.name: player machines
trust_boundaries.description: Machines owned or controlled by players, outside the system operator's control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Players run our game client on their own machines. We do not control those machines.

trust_boundaries.name: production network
trust_boundaries.description: The production network containing the lobby and game servers.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The client connects out to two things in our production network.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which customer support staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: our customer support staff work from the corporate network

assumptions.assumption: The lobby is internet-facing because it must be reachable from wherever a player is and is described as exposed.
assumptions.basis: The text says the lobby is reachable from wherever a player is and that both the lobby and game servers are exposed.

assumptions.assumption: The game server is internet-facing because it must be reachable from wherever a player is and is described as exposed.
assumptions.basis: The text says the game servers are reachable from wherever a player is and that both the lobby and game servers are exposed.

assumptions.assumption: The player database is confidential because it contains player account data that describes or identifies players.
assumptions.basis: The text says the moderation website looks at and acts on player accounts, and that the lobby and game servers access the player database.
